# Harsha Gardens

> More than three acres of gardens, a centrally air-conditioned hall for 1,000, a lake-view foyer and parking for about 1,000 cars.

Website: https://harshagardens.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99416 22222

## Contact
- Harsha Gardens · MGR Nagar bus stand, Karasangal, Tambaram–Padappai Road, Chennai 601301 · +91 99416 22222 · +91 99416 33333 · harshagardens@gmail.com

## Key facts
- 1,000 seats in the main hall
- 350 seats in the dining hall
- 23 air-conditioned rooms
- 1,000 cars parked, approximately

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C
- 1,000-seat hall
- Dining for 350
- 23 A/C rooms
- Lawn with colour fountain
- Lake-view foyer
- LED walls
- High ceilings & French windows
- Lift
- Huge wash area
- Parking for ~1,000 cars
- Valet parking on request

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Harsha Gardens hold?
Harsha Gardens' main hall seats 1,000, and the dining hall seats 350.

### Where is Harsha Gardens?
MGR Nagar bus stand, Karasangal, Tambaram–Padappai Road, Chennai 601301.

### What facilities does Harsha Gardens have?
Centralised A/C, 1,000-seat hall, Dining for 350, 23 A/C rooms, Lawn with colour fountain, Lake-view foyer, LED walls, High ceilings & French windows, Lift, Huge wash area, Parking for ~1,000 cars, Valet parking on request.

### How many cars can park?
Approximately 1,000 cars; valet parking can also be arranged.

### Are rooms available?
Yes, 23 fully furnished, air-conditioned rooms.

### How do I check if Harsha Gardens is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99416 22222.
